# pbs_notification_matcher_fields (Data Source)

Lists the metadata fields of Proxmox Backup Server notifications that a `pbs_notification_matcher` can match in `match_field`, such as `type` or `datastore`, with the values PBS knows for each: its notification types, datastores, media pools, job IDs and host name. A notification may carry other values, such as those of jobs created later. Reading them needs `Sys.Audit on /system/notifications`; datastores, jobs and media pools the provider's user may not see — without `Datastore.Audit` or `Tape.Audit` on them — are left out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The metadata fields of notifications, with the values PBS knows for each.
data "pbs_notification_matcher_fields" "all" {}

locals {
  matcher_values = {
    for f in data.pbs_notification_matcher_fields.all.fields : f.name => [for v in f.values : v.value]
  }
  datastores = local.matcher_values["datastore"]
}

# The built-in default-matcher leaves out the notifications of successful
# prune jobs. This matcher mails them to root@pam, for the datastores PBS has
# now; there is none to match until PBS has a datastore the provider's user
# may see.
resource "pbs_notification_matcher" "successful_prunes" {
  count = length(local.datastores) > 0 ? 1 : 0

  name           = "successful-prunes"
  target         = ["mail-to-root"]
  match_severity = ["info"]
  match_field = [
    "exact:type=prune",
    "exact:datastore=${join(",", local.datastores)}",
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `fields` (Attributes List) The fields, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Field name, such as `type`, as `match_field` names it: `exact:<name>=<value>`.
- `values` (Attributes List) Values PBS knows for the field, sorted; an empty list when it knows none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--values))

<a id="nestedatt--fields--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.values`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) What the value stands for, such as a datastore's comment; null when there is none.
- `value` (String) The value, such as `gc` for `type`.
